_note: Names one place goes by (city, airport name, airport codes) so that 'Lisbon Airport' and 'Humberto Delgado Airport (LIS)' are the same place for place_matches (27 Oct 2026: RateHawk Transfers' page said 'Humberto Delgado Airport (LIS)' and the check refused it twice). Lower case, no accents; only distinctive words, no generic ones (airport, station), no short words that other places use. Add a group for an airport when a page writes it another way; an airport of a city that has two (Rome: Fiumicino and Ciampino, Milan: Malpensa and Linate) is its own group, never the whole city.
